title: Magnetic field magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (1) must be expressed as B = mv₀/(2qL) or an equivalent form.

title: Motion time expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (2) must be expressed as t = 5πL/(3v₀) or an equivalent form.

title: Radius determination
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly determine the circular motion radius as r = 2L from the geometric constraints of entry and exit.

title: Centripetal force relation
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply Newton's second law for circular motion: qv₀B = mv₀²/r.

title: Arc angle calculation
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly identify the particle traverses 150° of the circular path based on the 30° entry angle and perpendicular exit condition.

title: Arc length calculation
description: Important Criteria: The solution must compute the arc length as (150/360)×2πr or equivalent fraction of the circumference.

title: Constant speed recognition
description: Optional Criteria: The solution may note that magnetic forces do no work, so speed remains constant at v₀ throughout.

title: Incorrect radius assumption
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the radius is incorrectly assumed to be L or derived from incomplete geometry.

title: Angle misinterpretation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the arc angle is taken as 30°, 90°, or 120° instead of 150°.

title: Formula misapplication
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if using t = 2πm/(qB) for full period without adjusting for the actual fraction traversed.
